answer_1.quote: NLG research focuses on generating natural language text from a variety of different inputs ... With respect to NCB languages, a few NLG systems and algorithms have been developed ... we developed a sentence generation system for isiZulu, focusing on handling various numerical types and generated a corpus of 771,643 grammatically correct sentences.
datasets: Generated isiZulu numeral sentence corpus (771,643 sentences)
answer_1.outputs: Grammatically correct isiZulu sentences with numbers verbalised as words

answer_4.quote: We generated 70 texts ... packaged into a single spreadsheet and collaboratively analysed by the two grammarians to determine whether each of them was valid or invalid, or state whether they were uncertain. If the verbalisation was invalid, they were asked to provide optional comments to describe the source of the error.
answer_4.guideline: Grammarians were instructed to label each generated string as valid, invalid, or uncertain and to provide comments explaining any errors.
